meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,AI 助手 NanoClaw 可以在 Emacs 里和你对话:你发消息,它回复到聊天区;你发送 org 文档片段,它把回答写成文档里的子标题。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 打开聊天窗口并发送消息,或对 org 文档的标题/选中区域发起发送时,AI 会接收并回复。

say.text: 帮我解释一下当前这个函数的错误信息。
say.note: 消息经聊天缓冲发送,回复显示在 Emacs。

say.text: 审查我选中的这段代码,指出问题。
say.note: 用发送命令后,意见以 org 子标题返回。

say.text: 把这段笔记润色并续写下去。
say.note: 原文通过 org 发送,修改稿出现在子节点。

howto.what_en: After installing, NanoClaw can chat with you from inside Emacs: it replies to your messages in the chat buffer, and when you send an org document fragment it writes the answer as a child heading under it.
howto.when_en: When you open the chat buffer in Emacs and send a message, or send the current org subtree/region with the send command, the AI receives it and replies.

say_en.text: Explain the error message for this function.
say_en.note: Reply appears in the Emacs chat buffer.

say_en.text: Review the region I selected and point out issues.
say_en.note: After sending, feedback comes back as an org child heading.

say_en.text: Polish this note and continue writing it.
say_en.note: Sent via org; the revision comes back as a child node.
